summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the Duplicate / Similarity Control Engine contract: it consumes parsed records, normalized records and version records, emits SimilarityRecord, DuplicateCluster and DeduplicationDecision outputs, preserves provenance, lineage, version context and stable identifiers, and keeps recommendations advisory-only. No material contract, boundary, metadata integrity or responsibility-separation violations were found.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Inline conformance smoke checks exercised the documented raw exact-duplicate happy path, source input immutability, deterministic identifier stability under input reordering, malformed missing-identifier rejection and version-successor downgrade to reviewable similarity without cluster or suppression recommendation. The declared test specification also covers sparse valid inputs, malformed fingerprint types, broken normalized references, invalid version context, unsupported identity-only payloads, normalized near-duplicate scoring, threshold boundary behavior, large duplicate batches and fail criteria for mutation or out-of-scope identity evidence.
test_results.notes: Reviewed functional_contract.md, operational_rules.md, technical_schema.md, test_spec.md, failure_modes_spec.md, usage_example.md and the Python codebase. The engine validates parsed, normalized and version records before comparison; rejects missing traceability, invalid fingerprints, broken references, invalid version context and unsupported payload shapes with structured DuplicateInputError codes; computes raw, parsed and normalized similarity deterministically; clamps scores to the 0.0 to 1.0 range; builds stable clusters from accepted exact or near-duplicate evidence; emits DeduplicationDecision objects with decision_status = recommended_only; carries source_ref, version_context_refs, method_version, produced_by_motor, produced_at, parent_id and version hashes; and does not mutate upstream records, resolve entity identity, evaluate quality or perform final curation.
